name: FCFF
formula_or_logic: FCFF = EBIT*(1-tax) - (CapEx-Depreciation) - Change in non-cash WC

name: Fundamental EBIT growth
formula_or_logic: g = ROC * Reinvestment Rate

name: Fundamental EPS growth
formula_or_logic: g = ROE * Retention Ratio

name: Stable reinvestment
formula_or_logic: Reinvestment Rate = g / ROC

name: Terminal value
formula_or_logic: TV_n = FCFF_(n+1)/(WACC_stable-g)

name: Cost of equity
formula_or_logic: Ke = Rf + Beta * ERP

name: WACC
formula_or_logic: WACC = E/V*Ke + D/V*Kd*(1-tax) [+ Preferred/V*Kp]

name: Levered beta
formula_or_logic: Beta_L = Beta_U * (1 + (1-tax)*D/E)
source: fcffginzu: Cost of capital worksheet C35

name: Pure-play cash correction
formula_or_logic: Beta_U_business = Beta_U_company / (1 - Cash/Firm Value)

name: Synthetic cost of debt
formula_or_logic: Kd = Rf + company default spread + country default spread

name: Market value of debt
formula_or_logic: PV(coupon=interest expense, principal=book debt, rate=current Kd, maturity=estimated maturity)
source: fcffginzu: Cost of capital worksheet C31

name: Non-cash working capital
formula_or_logic: NWC = (Current Assets-Cash) - (Current Liabilities-ST interest-bearing debt)

name: R&D-adjusted EBIT
formula_or_logic: Adjusted EBIT = Reported EBIT + Current R&D - R&D amortization

name: Research asset
formula_or_logic: Research Asset = Sum(prior/current R&D * unamortized portion)

name: Lease debt
formula_or_logic: Lease Debt = PV(future operating lease commitments, pretax Kd)

name: Lease-adjusted EBIT
formula_or_logic: Adjusted EBIT = Reported EBIT + Lease Expense - Lease Asset Depreciation

name: Business beta weighting
formula_or_logic: Beta_U_company = Sum(Beta_U_i * EstimatedValue_i / TotalEstimatedValue)
source: fcffginzu: Cost of capital worksheet K48/K64

name: Estimated business value weight
formula_or_logic: EstimatedValue_i = Segment Revenue_i * Industry EV/Sales_i
source: fcffginzu: Cost of capital worksheet J36:J47

name: Country ERP weighting
formula_or_logic: Company ERP = Sum(ExposureWeight_country * ERP_country)
source: fcffginzu: Cost of capital worksheet K18/K32

name: Default-adjusted risk-free rate
formula_or_logic: Riskfree currency rate = government bond yield - sovereign default spread
source: Country Default Spreads and Risk Premiums.pdf (2026-01-05)

name: Country risk premium
formula_or_logic: Country risk premium = adjusted default spread * relative equity-to-bond volatility
source: Country Default Spreads and Risk Premiums.pdf (2026-01-05)

name: Total country ERP
formula_or_logic: Country ERP = mature-market ERP + country risk premium
source: Country Default Spreads and Risk Premiums.pdf (2026-01-05)

name: Equity bridge
formula_or_logic: Equity = Operating assets + Cash + Non-operating assets - Debt - Minority interests - Option value

name: Option value dilution
formula_or_logic: Use dilution-adjusted option/warrant valuation with shares and options outstanding

name: Value of growth
formula_or_logic: Growth Value = Operating Asset Value - Assets-in-Place Value
